make_sim_create: create a simulator instance by calling make_sim with a registered simulator id and keyword arguments
make_sim_instantiate: instantiate a Habitat simulator using make_sim with the simulator name and configuration kwargs
review_make_sim: review the make_sim function that looks up a simulator from the registry and instantiates it
summarize_make_sim: summarize the make_sim function which retrieves a registered simulator class and calls it with kwargs
test_make_sim: test the make_sim function by passing a registered simulator id and verifying the returned instance
